df39a086bfb5ed8ebeb8050a35477f1df4c626d6.rationale: Evidence of lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis, along with a Breslow depth of 2.6 mm and 7 mitoses/mm2, strongly supports Melanoma as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Nevus of Ota

rejected.label: Spitz Nevus
rejected.why: Lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis contradict this diagnosis

rejected.label: Dysplastic Nevus
rejected.why: Lymph node metastasis with extracapsular extension and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis contradict this diagnosis

dfb6892608be0221a3935dc57fd2c3c77a65ad17.champion: Inflammatory Carcinoma of the Breast with Cutaneous Metastasis
dfb6892608be0221a3935dc57fd2c3c77a65ad17.rationale: Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels support cutaneous metastasis, and the presentation of a pruritic erythema lesion with multiple nodules over the operation site is consistent with inflammatory carcinoma

rejected.label: Radiation Dermatitis
rejected.why: Presence of carcinoma cells in lymphatic vessels contradicts radiation dermatitis

rejected.label: Inflammatory Breast Cancer
rejected.why: Negative for ER, PR, and HER2, and the presence of metastatic cells in the skin suggests a more specific diagnosis of cutaneous metastasis

rejected.label: Breast Cancer Recurrence
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of breast cancer, the specific findings of carcinoma cells in the skin and the clinical presentation suggest a more specific diagnosis of cutaneous metastasis

e1eaaa5ea89eebec5cb3fd13014b2134c771518b.rationale: The patient's symptoms of recurrent abdominal pain and syncope after drinking alcohol, along with a history of significant alcohol overconsumption, support Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy as the most likely diagnosis. While other options like Variant Angina could explain some ECG findings, the direct link to alcohol consumption and the absence of significant coronary stenosis lean towards Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy.

rejected.label: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings like left ventricular hypertrophy

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy

e2bbc4f6562da9be3d4c365a7e6e21ca4dda13d5.rationale: Global hypokinesia of right ventricle, dilated RV, and low RV ejection fraction support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Brugada Syndrome

rejected.why: contradicted by global hypokinesia of right ventricle and dilated RV

rejected.label: Right Ventricular Outflow Tract Tachycardia
rejected.why: less specific than Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy

e319d975e6325864e6da0152e5edb404f39564bc.rationale: Extensive epidermal necrosis with acantholysis and evolution of papules to purpuric rash support TEN, with SJS being a close runner-up due to overlapping symptoms but less specific evidence

rejected.label: Varicella Zoster Virus Infection

rejected.label: Severe COVID-19

rejected.label: Acne inversa

rejected.label: Photodermatitis

f6866d01f3c52061e67cf630b6befcf3a7dbd9eb.rationale: Perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, and positive immunohistochemical staining for CD33, CD123, CD4, and CD163, are characteristic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis

rejected.label: Juvenile xanthogranuloma

rejected.label: Infectious etiology

f6c27003638d4621ccc4fa8c38fe180dd5033986.rationale: Folliculocentric lesions and dermoscopic findings of central keratin plugs support Lichen spinulosus

ffa69889266b5f06aaf9d11ecd30f2da66f4315c.rationale: The patient's symptoms of acute, severe precordial chest pain radiating to their left arm, accompanied by dyspnea, dizziness, and sweating, along with ECG findings of broad-based, asymmetrical, tall upright T waves in precordial leads V2 through V5 and subtotal occlusion of the proximal left anterior descending artery, best support Acute Coronary Syndrome.
